title: コモンズ・黒皮鋼
description: 低コントラストの青灰色の黒皮鋼。家具フレームや工業プロップに。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
descriptionEn: Subtle blue-grey blackened steel for furniture frames and industrial props. Base color only. Set both axes to Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrapping. Opposite edges are not guaranteed to match under ordinary Repeat.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Mirror / mirrored-repeat sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: Charcoal blackened steel with subdued bluish grey mill scale and extremely fine brushed grain, low contrast, restrained industrial finish. NO seams, no bolts, no scratches that cross the whole tile.
